bounded_observations: Frog food raw base tag contains slime and magma_cube, while Frog.canEat rejects Slime sizes other than1; MagmaCube is actually whole-read here and extendsSlime. Base data does not establish current pack override deployment.

FrogAi installs sensor/StartAttacking and TONGUE activity. StartAttacking Forge BEHAVIOR_TARGET event may veto or replace target. ShootTongue caches unreachable target UUIDs with expiry100 on failed candidate path; list==5 eviction is not a general malformed-list size bound. No post-success hunting-cooldown assignment appears in whole ShootTongue.

Path.getDistToTarget is cached final-node Manhattan distance, not direct current Euclidean distance. Tongue MOVE_TO_TARGET tests current distance<1.75 and requests pull; CATCH uses postincrement oldvalue>=6, so bite is seventh CATCH branch execution if uninterrupted, not guaranteed six real game ticks. Behavior timeout compares supplied game time strictly>endTimestamp.

eatEntity calls normal inherited doHurtTarget and then checks isAlive before removeKILLED; animation does not directly grant froglight, heal, inventory insertion or guaranteed killing. itemSpawnPos is assigned but has no read/use in whole ShootTongue.

LivingEntity hurt/death/drop portions show Forge veto/gamerule/custom loot/drop event boundaries; Mob custom lootTable can replace default, LootTable applies Global Loot Modifiers, captured drops are only later add attempts. Actual loot result/add/pickup not verified.
